title.ko: 비유적 표현 · 흔한 관용구 · 상황별 사용
title.en: figurative expressions · common idioms · using them in context

explain.ko: 관용 표현은 단어의 뜻을 합친 것과 다른 비유적 의미를 가진 표현입니다. a piece of cake(식은 죽 먹기), break the ice(어색함을 풀다), cost an arm and a leg(엄청 비싸다), under the weather(몸이 안 좋다), out of the blue(갑자기), once in a blue moon(아주 드물게)가 대표적입니다. 문자 그대로 해석하면 틀리므로 하나의 덩어리로 외웁니다. 일상 대화와 비격식 글에서 자연스럽고, 학술적·공식적 글에서는 피합니다. 관용 표현의 일부를 바꾸면 의미가 사라지므로 형태를 그대로 유지합니다.
explain.en: Idioms have a figurative meaning that differs from the literal words. A piece of cake (very easy), break the ice (ease tension), cost an arm and a leg (very expensive), under the weather (unwell), out of the blue (unexpectedly), once in a blue moon (very rarely). Learn each as a chunk because a literal reading is wrong. They sound natural in conversation and informal writing, but avoid them in academic or formal texts. Don't change the words, or the meaning is lost.

notes.en: Similar idioms in other languages may use different images.

prompt.ko: 관용 표현 4개를 써서 하루의 일을 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about a day, using four idioms.

task.model: Today's exam was a piece of cake. It was our first meeting and awkward, but a joke broke the ice. An old friend called me out of the blue, which surprised me. I save a little every month for a rainy day.

model_trans.ko: 오늘 시험은 식은 죽 먹기였어요. 첫 만남이라 어색했지만 농담이 분위기를 풀어 주었어요. 갑자기 오랜 친구에게서 전화가 와서 깜짝 놀랐어요. 저는 만일을 위해 매달 조금씩 저축해요.
model_trans.en: Today's exam was a piece of cake. It was our first meeting and awkward, but a joke broke the ice. An old friend called me out of the blue, which surprised me. I save a little every month for a rainy day.
